🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, meeting the Sector Strength threshold, but Technology and Energy are negative and key stocks show mixed trends; leadership is Narrow (4/5 top performers from Consumer Discretionary and Materials). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads: GM (1W: +17.86% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND and RCL (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +15.60%) ABOVE TREND. Materials follows with PPG (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +18.77%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples is also firm, with WMT (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +22.47%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weakest at -7.17% for the week and -8.97% for the month; GOOGL (1W: -11.93% | 1M: -18.78%) and AMD (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -26.36%) are BELOW TREND. Energy is down 4.24% for the week, while Real Estate is the next-weakest positive sector at +1.82%.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: GM (1W: +17.86% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND; RCL (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +15.60%) ABOVE TREND; PPG (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +18.77%) ABOVE TREND; CHTR (1W: +13.07% | 1M: +5.72%) ABOVE TREND; CRH (1W: +13.06% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Consumer Discretionary and Materials).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTC (1W: -33.71% | 1M: -49.74%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -32.98% | 1M: -21.11%) BELOW TREND; AMD (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -26.36%) BELOW TREND; GOOGL (1W: -11.93% | 1M: -18.78%) BELOW TREND; CAT (1W: -11.34% | 1M: -27.25%) BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with a sharp additional drop in Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves: GM (1W: +17.86% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND, RCL (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +15.60%) ABOVE TREND and PPG (1W: +13.64% | 1M: +18.77%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: AAPL (1W: -1.63% | 1M: +1.39%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -2.50% | 1M: +7.67%) CORRECTION and XOM (1W: -2.64% | 1M: +9.55%) CORRECTION; watch for a trend break.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with sector returns of -7.17% for the week and -8.97% for the month across 24 stocks. NVDA (1W: -6.45% | 1M: -13.63%), MSFT (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -2.01%) and GOOGL (1W: -11.93% | 1M: -18.78%) are BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -1.63% | 1M: +1.39%) is in CORRECTION.

8. Financials Outlook?
Positive sector returns: +2.36% for the week and +5.78% for the month across 20 stocks. JPM (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +2.98%), V (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +17.98%) and MA (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +19.35%) are all ABOVE TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Firm, with sector returns of +2.23% for the week and +10.39% for the month across 17 stocks. LLY (1W: +10.31% | 1M: +23.46%), JNJ (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +5.68%) and PFE (1W: +2.95% | 1M: +10.32%) are ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: -2.50% | 1M: +7.67%) is in CORRECTION.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio stance?
Stay selective in the NEUTRAL regime; favor diversified exposure across positive sectors rather than making a strong Growth or Value style call. Monitor Technology weakness and CAT (1W: -11.34% | 1M: -27.25%) BELOW TREND; broad sector strength is tempered by narrow top-stock leadership and major divergences.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CRH (1W: +13.06% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +2.95% | 1M: +10.32%) ABOVE TREND; monitor follow-through after positive earnings catalysts. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -33.71% | 1M: -49.74%) BELOW TREND and CAT (1W: -11.34% | 1M: -27.25%) BELOW TREND; watch for stabilization after continued weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (+5.21% 1W; +10.24% 1M) and Materials (+4.72% 1W; +10.02% 1M), with 9/11 sectors positive overall. BEARISH: Technology (-7.17% 1W; -8.97% 1M) and Energy (-4.24% 1W; +6.06% 1M); monitor whether Technology weakness broadens.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Numeric price levels were not supplied; use trend confirmation as the trigger. NVDA (1W: -6.45% | 1M: -13.63%) BELOW TREND and AAPL (1W: -1.63% | 1M: +1.39%) CORRECTION need stabilization, while JPM (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +2.98%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +10.31% | 1M: +23.46%) ABOVE TREND are continuation watches.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PLTR (+80): raised outlook after an earnings beat; PLTR (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -5.52%) BELOW TREND, a price-news divergence. CRH (+65): resilient revenue and buyback; CRH (1W: +13.06% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND, confirming the news. PFE (+60): strong quarter and slightly higher outlook; PFE (1W: +2.95% | 1M: +10.32%) ABOVE TREND, confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CHTR (-50): target cut; CHTR (1W: +13.07% | 1M: +5.72%) ABOVE TREND, diverging from sentiment. CAT (-45): target cut puts margin premium in focus; CAT (1W: -11.34% | 1M: -27.25%) BELOW TREND, confirming weakness. AAPL (-40): margin warning; AAPL (1W: -1.63% | 1M: +1.39%) CORRECTION, while TSLA (-45): weaker China wholesale sales; TSLA (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND, diverging from sentiment.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, with style mixed / no clear leadership; breadth is 9/11 sectors positive, but leadership is narrow. GM (1W: +17.86% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +10.31% | 1M: +23.46%) ABOVE TREND show relative strength. Monitor the major divergences, especially PLTR (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -5.52%) BELOW TREND despite bullish news sentiment.
